Monkeys are the enemies of farmers in Nepal.

At dawn, rural communities across the country gather to fan out across fields carrying slings, sticks and homemade noise cannons and keep watch on the tree line. Some bring dogs, others shout into the forest.

The aim is to stop hordes of macaques from destroying crops that can vanish in minutes.

The daily ritual reflects a growing crisis across rural Nepal. Farmers say the monkey raids have become one of the biggest threats to their livelihoods despite years of failed efforts to drive the aggressive animals away. It also mirrors a broader shift in the countryside as villages lose people to cities and overseas jobs, leaving fewer hands to farm or defend the land.

All rights reserved. )

Villagers have tried almost every deterrent they can think of: slings, stones, laser lights, dogs and homemade noise cannons. Last month, a rural municipality in eastern Nepal closed schools and government offices for three days so hundreds of residents could drive monkeys into the surrounding forests. Within days, the monkeys were back.

open image in gallery {"id":"trigger-autogallery-26320","index":2} Krishna Bahadur Khadka, 73, shows scars from monkey bites after he was attacked while guarding his crop in Dharamghar, Dolakha district, about 86 kilometers (53 miles) east of Kathmandu, Nepal, Friday, July 24, 2026 ( Copyright 2026 The Associated Press. All rights reserved. )

Dhurba Rai, a lawmaker from eastern Nepal, said the problem intensified about a decade ago after the government confiscated firearms that villagers had long used to protect crops and livestock during the Maoist insurgency. Without that deterrent, he said, the monkeys became increasingly bold.

For Debaka Karki, 71, those debates feel remote. Most mornings she stands guard over her small plot, watching the surrounding trees for movement.

On one recent occasion, she stepped away for only a few minutes to refill a bottle of warm water. By the time she returned, a troop of monkeys had swept through the field, stripping away crops she had spent months growing.

Her sons have moved to Kathmandu for work, leaving her and her husband to manage the farm alone. With few younger people left in the village, there is no one to help keep the animals away.

In Dharmghar, a village in Dolakha District, the population has fallen from nearly 800 people in 2017 to about 150 now, according to Ganesh Karki, who heads the local community forest. Of its roughly 210 households, only about half remain occupied after younger residents left for cities and overseas jobs.

The abandoned fields and homes, Karki said, have given monkeys more room to spread.

Krishna Bahadur Khadka, 73, was attacked by a troop of monkeys last year. They knocked him to the ground, bit his back and left him bedridden for nearly four months. He has never fully recovered from the attack.

description: Dr. Dhawalshamsher Rana to Register Jay Nepal Party on August 12  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Kathmandu. Leader Dr. Dhawalshamsher Rana, who is preparing to form the Jay Nepal Party, has said that the party will be registered at the Election Commission on Shrawan 28.

Speaking at a program organized in Kathmandu on Thursday, leader Rana clarified that the Jay Nepal Party is being formed with the main goal of establishing a Hindu state.

He also informed that Durga Prasai will be given the responsibility of the supreme leader in the party, which will be registered under his chairmanship. Speaking at the program, Rana clarified that they are looking for a monarchy that will not be actively involved in politics but will have a guardianship and national protector role.

Mentioning that there is a tradition of all castes, ethnic groups, and religious followers respecting the monarchy, he claimed that the country has fallen into crisis after the monarchy was removed.

His statement is that the new party has been born to re-establish the Hindu state.

publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Kathmandu. The market saw a line when Nepal Oil Corporation directed industries to send only 7.1 kg weight gas cylinders to the market from January 29 to June 30. Less than 6 months later, a gas crisis has reappeared in the market.

Currently, there is a serpentine line of the general public at the Nepal Gas industry in Balaju and the Oil Corporation office in Teku. The Oil Corporation, the government body responsible for importing gas and petroleum products, claims that more gas than usual is being sent to the market.

According to the Oil Corporation, an average of one lakh eight thousand gas cylinders are consumed daily across Nepal. However, even though gas has been imported daily for the last 10 days to supply one lakh fifty-six thousand four hundred gas cylinders, a shortage persists in the market.

The Corporation's data shows that 106 bullets of gas were imported on July 27. One bullet contains approximately 18 tons of gas, which is enough to fill 14.2 kg of gas in an average of 1250 cylinders. However, as soon as filled cylinders started being sent to the market, consumers began lining up at gas distribution centers.

For ease of supply in the Kathmandu Valley, the Corporation has arranged for Nepal, HP, Shriram, Everest, and Sugam brand gas cylinders to be available at the old office in Teku. Similarly, all 59 industries across the country have been instructed to provide gas if consumers reach the premises. However, for the past week, instead of easing, the gas supply has become more difficult.

According to the Ministry of Industry, Commerce and Supplies, gas supply is most critical in Kathmandu, Bhaktapur, Makwanpur, Sunsari, Surkhet, Parsa, Pyuthan, and Doti. The ministry's records show that consumers in these districts have to wait for hours at gas dealers and industries but still do not get gas.

title: Probe committee submits report on Ganesh Nepali self-immolation - The Kathmandu Post
description: Probe committee submits report on Ganesh Nepali self-immolation  The Kathmandu Post
publisher.title: The Kathmandu Post
full_article:
A government-appointed committee investigating the self-immolation and death of Ganesh Nepali in Kathmandu has submitted its report, paving the way for the Cabinet to decide on any further action.

The panel, led by former High Court judge Keshab Prasad Bastola, submitted its findings on Sunday, according to one of its members.

The committee interviewed eyewitnesses, officials from the Kathmandu Metropolitan City Police, Nepal Police personnel stationed near the scene, and doctors involved in Nepali's treatment. It also reviewed CCTV footage from the site of the incident.

The Cabinet formed the panel on July 22, appointing Bastola to lead an independent investigation into the case.

A separate police inquiry had already examined the incident. The panel, headed by Deputy Inspector General Gobinda Dhakal of the Kathmandu Valley Police Office, interviewed 21 people, including eyewitnesses, municipal police officers and other individuals connected to the case.

Nepali died while undergoing treatment after setting himself on fire outside the Department of Passports in Tripureshwor on July 9.

He had attempted self-immolation by dousing himself with petrol siphoned from his motorcycle after an altercation with Kathmandu Metropolitan City police over a parking fine. He later succumbed to his injuries in hospital.

His death triggered widespread public outrage. Family members initially refused to claim his body, alleging that the actions of municipal police had driven him to take the drastic step.

The incident sparked nationwide protests against the government. The demonstrations ended only after the government reached an agreement with the family to address their demands, including an independent investigation into the incident.

title: Jay Nepal Party to Advocate for Hindu Kingdom, Constitutional Monarchy - Ratopati
description: Jay Nepal Party to Advocate for Hindu Kingdom, Constitutional Monarchy  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article: Kathmandu. Jay Nepal Party Chairman Dr. Dhawal Shamsher Rana has stated that the new political party formed by them will advance Hindu sovereignty, the restoration of constitutional monarchy, and the democratic system as its main political agenda. He said this while providing information about the newly formed Jay Nepal Party at a press conference organized in Kathmandu on Thursday. He also clarified that their party does not envision an active monarchy. He stated that they want to restore a constitutional monarchy that will be in a role of guardianship, national unity, and protector of the nation, not a monarchy that interferes in politics. Rana claimed that removing the Hindu state system from Nepal was a wrong decision and stated that it would be restored peacefully through both street and parliamentary means. He said that the party will take a policy of respecting all religious followers including Kirat and Buddhist, based on Sanatana Dharma. He claimed that the newly formed party will be youth and women-centric, and informed that the average age of the party's central committee is aimed to be 45 years. He stated that the organization will be built by ensuring representation from districts and constituencies, and the decision-making process will be conducted on the basis of majority and consensus. He claimed that the party will prioritize collective leadership and internal democracy by ending the tendency of leadership imposing decisions, and mentioned that the party will be made a common organization for all members, not for any individual. He said, 'The main idea of the party is the imagination and effort to create a Hindu sovereign state by including Kirat and Buddhist religions, which are part of the Sanatana Dharma, and respecting other religious followers. The name of this party will be Jay Nepal Party.' Speaking about party registration and structure, he added, 'Discussions are still ongoing regarding its election symbol. We will register the party at the Election Commission on the 28th of Shrawan. This party will be democratic, where youth and women will be given proper space.' He mentioned the commitment to keep the average age of the party's central committee at 45 years, saying, 'We have committed to keeping the average age of the party's central committee at 45 years. This will be a youth-centric and women-centric democratic party as demanded by the present times.' Regarding the decision-making process and internal democracy, he said, 'We will make decisions on every issue after thorough discussion, preferably by consensus, and if not, by minority and majority. This will not be anyone's personal party; we will make it a party that all members and the Nepali people embrace.' Discussing the atmosphere within the party, he added, 'We will make this party a happy party. So far, people in other parties are not happy; they are fighting and abusing each other. Work cannot proceed smoothly until people are happy.' Clarifying the form of the monarchy, he said, 'This will be a Hindu sovereign state with a king, which Nepal has lost, based on Sanatana Dharma. We are not looking for a monarchy that engages in politics; politics will be done by the sons and daughters of Nepal. The monarchy will remain in the role of guardian and protector of the nation.' Speaking about Nepal's secularism, he said, 'There was only one Hindu state in the world, which the leaders destroyed. The 82 percent Hindus and 94 percent Omkar family residents of Nepal are not happy with this. Therefore, this party has been born to restore the Hindu sovereign state peacefully through the streets or parliament.' Rana informed that they will apply for party registration at the Election Commission on the 28th of Shrawan. He stated that he will lead the party and Durga Prasai has been put forward as the chief universally accepted leader. He informed that discussions are ongoing regarding the party's election symbol. He said that the party's organization will be expanded up to the village level, and they will participate in the upcoming local level elections.

रक्षक के भूमिका म॑ होतै । राणा नेपाल सँ हिन्दू राज्य व्यवस्था के हटाबय के गलत निर्णय के दावा करैत सड़क आ संसदीय दुनू माध्यम स शांतिपूर्ण तरीका स एकरा बहाल करबाक बात कहलनि। ओ कहलनि जे, पार्टी सनातन धर्म के आधार पर किरात आ बौद्ध सहित सब धार्मिक अनुयायी के सम्मान के नीति अपनाओत। ओ नवगठित पार्टी युवा आ महिला केंद्रित हेबाक दावा केलनि, आ पार्टीक केंद्रीय समितिक औसत उम्र 45 वर्षक लक्ष्य रखबाक सूचना देलनि। हुनी कहलकै कि जिला आरू क्षेत्र स॑ प्रतिनिधित्व सुनिश्चित करी क॑ संगठन के निर्माण करलऽ जैतै, आरू बहुमत आरू सहमति के आधार प॑ निर्णय लेबै के प्रक्रिया करलऽ जैतै । ओ दावा केलनि जे पार्टी नेतृत्व थोपबाक प्रवृत्ति के समाप्त क सामूहिक नेतृत्व आ आंतरिक लोकतंत्र के प्राथमिकता देत, आ पार्टी के कोनो व्यक्ति के लेल नहि, सब सदस्य के लेल साझा संगठन बनेबाक उल्लेख केलनि। ओ कहलनि जे, पार्टी के मुख्य विचार सनातन धर्म के हिस्सा रहल किरात आ बौद्ध धर्म के शामिल क हिन्दू सार्वभौम राज्य बनेबाक कल्पना आ प्रयास आ अन्य धार्मिक अनुयायी के सम्मान अछि। एहि पार्टीक नाम जय नेपाल पार्टी होयत।' पार्टी पंजीकरण आरू संरचना के बारे म॑ बोलतें हुअ॑ हुनी आरू कहलकै कि एकरऽ चुनाव चिन्ह के संबंध म॑ अखनी भी चर्चा जारी छै । हम सब श्रावण के 28 तारीख के चुनाव आयोग में पार्टी के रजिस्ट्रेशन करा देब। ई पार्टी लोकतांत्रिक होयत, जतय युवा आ महिला के उचित जगह देल जायत।' ओ पार्टी के केन्द्रीय समिति के औसत उम्र ४५ साल राखय के प्रतिबद्धता के जिक्र करैत कहलनि जे, हम पार्टी के केंद्रीय समिति के औसत उम्र 45 साल राखय के प्रतिबद्धता जतौने छी। ई वर्तमान समय के मांग के अनुसार युवा केंद्रित आ महिला केंद्रित लोकतांत्रिक पार्टी होयत।' निर्णय प्रक्रिया आरू आतंरिक लोकतंत्र के संबंध म॑ हुनी कहलकै कि हम्में हर मुद्दा प॑ गहन चर्चा के बाद निर्णय लेबै, बेहतर छै कि सहमति स॑, आरू अगर नै त॑ अल्पसंख्यक आरू बहुमत स॑ । ई ककरो व्यक्तिगत पार्टी नहि होयत; हम एकरा एहन पार्टी बना देब जेकरा सब सदस्य आ नेपाली जनता अपनाबय।' पार्टी के भीतर के माहौल पर चर्चा करैत ओ आगू कहलनि जे, हम सब एहि पार्टी के खुशहाल पार्टी बना देब। एखन धरि आन पार्टीक लोक खुश नहिं छथि; एक दोसरा सॅं लड़ि रहल छथि आ गारि-गरौबलि क' रहल छथि । जा धरि लोक खुश नहि भ' जायत ता धरि काज सुचारू रूपेँ नहि आगू बढ़ि सकैत अछि।' राजतंत्रक रूप स्पष्ट करैत ओ कहलनि जे, ई एकटा राजाक संग हिन्दू सार्वभौम राज्य होयत, जकरा नेपाल हारल अछि, सनातन धर्मक आधार पर। हम सब एहन राजतंत्र के तलाश में नहिं छी जे राजनीति में लागल हो; राजनीति नेपालक बेटा-बेटी द्वारा कयल जायत। राजतंत्र राष्ट्रक रक्षक आ रक्षकक भूमिका मे रहत।' नेपालक धर्मनिरपेक्षताक बात करैत ओ कहलनि जे, ‘दुनिया मे एकटा हिन्दू राज्य छल, जकरा नेता लोकनि नष्ट क’ देलनि । नेपालक ८२ प्रतिशत हिन्दू आ ९४ प्रतिशत ओंकार परिवारक निवासी एहि बातसँ खुश नहि छथि । अतः ई पार्टी सड़क या संसद के माध्यम स शांतिपूर्ण तरीका स हिन्दू संप्रभु राज्य के बहाल करय लेल पैदा भेल अछि।' राणा कहलनि जे, श्रावण के 28 तारीख के चुनाव आयोग मे पार्टी पंजीकरण के लेल आवेदन करताह। ओ पार्टीक नेतृत्व करबाक बात कहलनि आ दुर्गा प्रसाई केँ मुख्य सर्वमान्य नेताक रूप मे आगू राखल गेल अछि । पार्टी के चुनाव चिन्ह के संबंध में चर्चा जारी अछि से जानकारी देलनि। ओ कहलनि जे, पार्टी के संगठन के विस्तार गाम स्तर तक कायल जायत, आ आगामी स्थानीय स्तर के चुनाव में ओ सब भाग लेताह।

title: International Tibetan Studies Conference Postponed Amidst Chinese Concerns - Ratopati
description: International Tibetan Studies Conference Postponed Amidst Chinese Concerns  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Kathmandu. Any program related to Tibet in Nepal is viewed with suspicion. Mostly, such programs are not allowed to happen, and if they do, they become controversial.

China has a special interest in such programs. China takes a special interest when any program related to Tibet is to be held. It is found that China tries to prevent the program from happening, and if it is allowed, it is done only after thorough investigation.

The international conference on 'International Association of Tibetan Studies' scheduled to be held in Nepal has been postponed. The program, announced to be held in Nepal four years ago, has been postponed at the request of the government.

All preparations for the program, which was to be held from August 7, were complete. Some guests and scholars were preparing to come, and some were on their way, but at the last moment, the government caused the program to be postponed.

Earlier, in the second week of January, a Tibetan Buddhist spiritual leader, Jonang Gyaltsab Rinpoche, came to Nepal for a discourse. That also faced strong criticism. The government's provision of high security for Tibetan spiritual leader Rinpoche, who arrived in Nepal on January 15, was criticized by political parties and at the diplomatic level.

Former Prime Minister Jhalanath Khanal and UML Vice-Chairman Ram Bahadur Thapa 'Badal' opposed the visit of spiritual leader Gyaltsab to Nepal. They accused the government of anti-China activities by facilitating the visit of spiritual leader Rinpoche.

The Chinese Embassy in Nepal also took an interest in the matter. The Chinese Ambassador met with officials from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and expressed his interest. On June 13, a representative from Nepal was supposed to attend the swearing-in ceremony of the head of the Tibetan government-in-exile, Penpa Tsering. The Government of Nepal had also received an invitation from the Dalai Lama, but due to external pressure, no one from Nepal participated.

On July 7, the celebration of the birthday of the Tibetan spiritual leader Dalai Lama, who is living in exile in India, faced widespread protest. Some former ambassadors and political figures issued statements protesting that the government had acted against the 'One China policy'.

Previous governments had completely banned the celebration of the Dalai Lama's birthday. Even with police intervention, the celebration of the Dalai Lama's birthday would be stopped. However, this time, despite the program being held with the government's permission, there was significant protest.

Similarly, the international conference on Tibetan studies has been suddenly postponed. Prof. Dr. Sagarraj Sharma, Director of the Himalayan Center for Asian Studies at Kathmandu University, stated that the program was postponed at the government's request.

He explained that the program was postponed after being urged not to hold it, stating that it would not be appropriate in the current situation, and clarified that the postponement was due to the government's request, although the reasons for the request were known to the government.

Kathmandu University, which was coordinating the program in Nepal, has withdrawn from the program. He stated that the International Association of Tibetan Studies has already been informed that the program will not take place.

Preparations for the program were being made in coordination with the government, and the government was informed about every aspect of the program. Preparations were underway in coordination, but suddenly information came that the program should not be held, he said. The program preparations were almost complete.

A team of Tibetology experts from China also visited and took complete information about the program preparations. Scholars from China were also scheduled to participate in the conference, but the program has been suddenly postponed.

The inauguration of the international conference was scheduled to be held in Dhulikhel, and the rest of the program was to take place at the Soaltee Hotel. With all preparations complete, this was purely an academic program. It was scheduled to feature various discussions and debates on Tibet and Buddhism. Scholars from various countries were scheduled to present their papers.

The organizers had already received all the details about who would present what. Nevertheless, a professor from KU lamented that the program was postponed under suspicion. He said, 'Postponing this program has not sent a good message about Nepal internationally.'

Scholars from 40 countries, including India, China, and the United States, were to participate in this program. They were going to pay a significant amount to participate in the program. Now, it is up to the International Association of Tibetan Studies to decide where to hold the program, said the KU official.

What about Rabi Lamichhane's China visit?

Rabi Lamichhane, chairman of the Rastriya Swatantra Party (RSP), had an uncertain China visit due to this program. However, sources from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs indicate that the possibility has now increased.

Although the date has not been fixed, preparations are underway, said an official from the ministry. As this is a party-level visit, the ministry will only coordinate, and the party will handle all other matters, so the ministry does not have much information, the official said, adding that Chairman Lamichhane is scheduled to visit China, and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs is preparing to coordinate it.

Lamichhane visited India in May at the invitation of the Bharatiya Janata Party. Similarly, Foreign Minister Shishir Khanal also visited India. He visited India and then went to China.

During his China visit, he made arrangements for Chairman Lamichhane's visit. After the Foreign Minister returned from China, preparations for Chairman Lamichhane's visit began.

However, China was objecting to the International Association of Tibetan Studies conference being held in Nepal. This increased the risk of Chairman Lamichhane's visit being affected. As it concerns the relationship between the two countries, Chairman Lamichhane also suggested that it would be better if the program was postponed.

Accordingly, Foreign Minister Khanal also sent a suggestion to the Prime Minister's Office to postpone the program. Earlier, Home Minister Sudhan Gurung had expressed that a program related to Tibetan studies would be held. After that, China became even more interested in the program.

After becoming Prime Minister following the Janji movement, Sushila Karki was congratulated by the Dalai Lama. This was possibly the first such incident in Nepal's politics. The Dalai Lama had not congratulated any Prime Minister in this manner before.

After Balendra Shah (Balen) was appointed Prime Minister, the head of the Tibetan Central Administration, Sikyong Penpa Tsering, extended congratulations and best wishes. Balen took the oath of office and secrecy on April 14.

In the congratulatory message sent by Chief Tsering, he was mentioned as emerging as the youngest Prime Minister to date. The message stated that Balen's rise following the recent youth-led movement is a strong symbol of the aspirations of the Nepali people.

काठमांडू। नेपाल मे तिब्बत स संबंधित कोनो कार्यक्रम शंका स देखल जाइत अछि । बेसी काल एहन कार्यक्रम नहि होबय देल जाइत अछि, आ जौं हो त' विवादित भ' जाइत अछि.

चीन के एहि तरहक कार्यक्रम मे विशेष रुचि अछि. चीन तखन विशेष रुचि लैत अछि जखन तिब्बत सं जुड़ल कोनो कार्यक्रम होबय वाला अछि. पता चलै छै कि चीन ई कार्यक्रम क॑ नै होबै के कोशिश करै छै, आरू अगर अनुमति मिलै छै त॑ ई काम पूरा जांच के बाद ही करलऽ जाय छै ।

नेपालमे होबय बला ‘अन्तर्राष्ट्रीय तिब्बती अध्ययन संघ’ विषयक अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय सम्मेलन स्थगित कएल गेल अछि । चारि साल पहिने नेपाल मे होबय बला कार्यक्रम सरकार के आग्रह पर स्थगित क देल गेल अछि.

7 अगस्त स होबय वाला एहि कार्यक्रम क सबटा तैयारी पूरा भ गेल। किछु पाहुन आ विद्वान आबय के तैयारी में छलाह, आ किछु रस्ता में, मुदा अंतिम क्षण में सरकार के कारण कार्यक्रम स्थगित भ गेल.

एहि सं पहिने जनवरी के दोसर सप्ताह में तिब्बती बौद्ध आध्यात्मिक नेता जोनांग ग्यालत्सब रिंपोछे प्रवचन के लेल नेपाल आयल छलाह. जेकरा सेहो कड़ा आलोचना के सामना करय पड़ल। १५ जनवरीके नेपाल पहुँचल तिब्बती आध्यात्मिक नेता रिंपोछेके सरकारके उच्च सुरक्षाके व्यवस्थाके राजनीतिक दलसब आ कूटनीतिक स्तरमे आलोचना भेल ।

पूर्व प्रधानमन्त्री झलनाथ खनाल आ एमाले उपाध्यक्ष रामबहादुर थापा ‘बदल’ आध्यात्मिक नेता ग्यालत्सबक नेपाल यात्राक विरोध केलनि । ओ सब आध्यात्मिक नेता रिंपोछे के यात्रा के सुविधा द क सरकार पर चीन विरोधी गतिविधि के आरोप लगौलनि।

नेपाल मे चीनी दूतावास सेहो एहि मामला मे रुचि लेलक। चीन के राजदूत विदेश मंत्रालय के अधिकारी सब स भेंट क अपन रुचि व्यक्त केलथि। 13 जून कए नेपाल स एकटा प्रतिनिधि निर्वासित तिब्बती सरकार क प्रमुख पेनपा त्सेरिंग क शपथ ग्रहण समारोह मे शामिल हेबाक छल। नेपाल सरकार के सेहो दलाई लामा के आमंत्रण भेटल छल, मुदा बाहरी दबाव के कारण नेपाल स कियो भाग नै लेलक।

७ जुलाई क॑ भारत म॑ निर्वासन म॑ रह॑ वाला तिब्बती आध्यात्मिक नेता दलाई लामा केरऽ जन्मदिन मनाबै प॑ व्यापक विरोध के सामना करना पड़लै । कुछ पूर्व राजदूत आरू राजनीतिक हस्ती न॑ बयान जारी करी क॑ विरोध करलकै कि सरकार न॑ ‘एक चीन नीति’ के खिलाफ काम करलकै ।

पिछला सरकार दलाई लामा के जन्मदिन मनाबय पर पूर्ण रूप सं रोक लगा देने छल. पुलिस हस्तक्षेप स सेहो दलाई लामा क जन्मदिन मनाबय बंद भ जाइत। मुदा एहि बेर सरकार के अनुमति सं कार्यक्रम के आयोजन के बावजूद काफी विरोध भेल.

तहिना तिब्बती अध्ययन पर अंतर्राष्ट्रीय सम्मेलन सेहो अचानक स्थगित भ गेल अछि । काठमांडू विश्वविद्यालय के हिमालयन सेंटर फॉर एशियन स्टडीज के निदेशक प्रो.

ओ बतौलनि जे वर्तमान स्थिति मे ई उचित नहि होयत से कहैत कार्यक्रम के आयोजन नहि करबाक आग्रह केलाक बाद स्थगित कयल गेल अछि, आ स्पष्ट केलनि जे स्थगन सरकार के आग्रह के कारण भेल अछि, हालांकि आग्रह के कारण सरकार के पता छल।

नेपालमे कार्यक्रमके संयोजक रहल काठमाण्डौ विश्वविद्यालय कार्यक्रमसँ हटि गेल अछि । हुनकऽ कहना छै कि इंटरनेशनल एसोसिएशन आफ तिब्बती स्टडीज क॑ ई कार्यक्रम नै होतै के जानकारी देलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

सरकार के समन्वय में कार्यक्रम के तैयारी भ रहल छल, आ कार्यक्रम के हर पहलू के बारे में सरकार के जानकारी देल गेल छल. समन्वय स तैयारी चलि रहल छल, मुदा अचानक सूचना आबि गेल जे कार्यक्रम नहि होबाक चाही। कार्यक्रमक तैयारी लगभग पूरा भ गेल छल।

चीन केरऽ तिब्बत विज्ञान विशेषज्ञऽ के टीम भी दौरा करी क॑ कार्यक्रम केरऽ तैयारी के बारे म॑ पूरा जानकारी लेलकै । एहि सम्मेलन मे चीन स विद्वान कए सेहो भाग लेबाक कार्यक्रम छल, मुदा कार्यक्रम अचानक स्थगित भ गेल अछि।

अंतर्राष्ट्रीय सम्मेलन के उद्घाटन धुलिखेल में होबय वाला छल, आ बाकी कार्यक्रम सोलटी होटल में होबय वाला छल. सबटा तैयारी पूरा भ गेलाक बाद ई विशुद्ध रूप स शैक्षणिक कार्यक्रम छल। एहि मे तिब्बत आ बौद्ध धर्म पर विभिन्न तरहक चर्चा आ बहस होएबाक कार्यक्रम छल । विभिन्न देशक विद्वान लोकनि अपन शोधपत्र प्रस्तुत करबाक कार्यक्रम छल ।

आयोजक लोकनि केँ एहि बातक सबटा विवरण भेटि चुकल छलनि जे के की प्रस्तुत करत। एकर बादो केयू के एकटा प्रोफेसर एहि बात के दुख जतौलनि जे एहि कार्यक्रम के शंका के कारण स्थगित क देल गेल. ओ कहलनि जे, 'एहि कार्यक्रम के स्थगित करला सं अंतरराष्ट्रीय स्तर पर नेपाल के बारे मे नीक संदेश नहि देल गेल अछि.'

एहि कार्यक्रम मे भारत, चीन, आ अमेरिका सहित 40 देशक विद्वान लोकनि केँ भाग लेबाक छलनि। कार्यक्रम मे भाग लेबय लेल ओ सब काफी राशि देबय वाला छलाह. केयू के अधिकारी के कहनाय छनि जे आब ई फैसला इंटरनेशनल एसोसिएशन ऑफ तिब्बती स्टडीज पर अछि जे ई कार्यक्रम कतय आयोजित कएल जाए.

रबी लामिछाने के चीन यात्रा के की कहब?

राष्ट्रीय स्वतंत्र पार्टी (आरएसपी) के अध्यक्ष रबी लामिछाने के एहि कार्यक्रम के कारण चीन के अनिश्चित यात्रा भेल छल. मुदा विदेश मंत्रालय के सूत्र सं पता चलैत अछि जे आब संभावना बढ़ि गेल अछि.

हालांकि तारीख तय नहि भेल अछि, मुदा तैयारी चलि रहल अछि, मंत्रालय के एकटा अधिकारी कहलनि। ई पार्टी स्तरीय यात्रा होय के कारण मंत्रालय केवल समन्वय करतै, आरू पार्टी बाकी सब मामला संभालतै, ई लेली मंत्रालय के पास बहुत जानकारी नै छै, अधिकारी नँ कहलकै कि अध्यक्ष लामिछाने चीन के दौरा करै के छै, आरू विदेश मंत्रालय एकरौ समन्वय करै के तैयारी करी रहलौ छै ।

भारतीय जनता पार्टी के आमंत्रण पर मई महीना मे लामिछाने भारत के दौरा केने छलाह. तहिना विदेश मंत्री शिशिर खनाल सेहो भारत दौरा केलथि। भारत गेलाह आ फेर चीन गेलाह।

चीन यात्रा के दौरान अध्यक्ष लामिछाने के यात्रा के व्यवस्था केलनि। विदेश मंत्री के चीन सं वापसी के बाद अध्यक्ष लामिछाने के यात्रा के तैयारी शुरू भ गेल.

मुदा चीन नेपाल मे भ रहल इंटरनेशनल एसोसिएशन ऑफ तिब्बती स्टडीज सम्मेलन पर आपत्ति क रहल छल । एहि स अध्यक्ष लामिछाने क यात्रा प्रभावित हेबाक खतरा बढ़ि गेल। जेना कि ई दुनु देश के संबंध के बात छै, अध्यक्ष लामिछाने न॑ ई भी सुझाव देलकै कि अगर ई कार्यक्रम स्थगित करी देलऽ जाय त॑ बेहतर होतै ।

तदनुसार विदेश मंत्री खनाल सेहो प्रधानमंत्री कार्यालय मे कार्यक्रम स्थगित करबाक सुझाव पठेलनि। एहि सं पहिने गृहमंत्री सुधन गुरुंग तिब्बती अध्ययन सं जुड़ल कार्यक्रम के आयोजन करय के बात व्यक्त केने छलाह. एकर बाद चीन कए एहि कार्यक्रम मे आओर बेसी रुचि जागल।

जंजी आन्दोलन के बाद प्रधानमंत्री बनला के बाद सुशीला कार्की के दलाई लामा के तरफ सं बधाई देल गेल छल. संभवतः नेपालक राजनीति मे ई पहिल एहन घटना छल । दलाई लामा पहिने एहि तरहे कोनो प्रधानमंत्री कए बधाई नहि देने छलाह।

बलेन्द्र शाह (बालेन) के प्रधानमंत्री नियुक्त करला के बाद तिब्बती केन्द्रीय प्रशासन के प्रमुख सिक्योंग पेनपा त्सेरिंग न॑ बधाई आरू शुभकामना देलकै । बालेन 14 अप्रैल कए पद आ गोपनीयता क शपथ लेलथि।

चीफ त्सेरिंग द्वारा भेजल गेल बधाई संदेश मे हुनका एखन धरि के सबस कम उम्र के प्रधानमंत्री के रूप मे उभरैत उल्लेख कएल गेल छल. संदेश मे कहल गेल अछि जे हाल मे युवा नेतृत्व मे भेल आन्दोलन के बाद बलेन के उदय नेपाली जनता के आकांक्षा के सशक्त प्रतीक अछि ।

title: Jay Nepal Party Chairman Criticizes Rastriya Prajatantra Party's Handling of Monarchy and Hindu State Agendas - Ratopati
description: Jay Nepal Party Chairman Criticizes Rastriya Prajatantra Party's Handling of Monarchy and Hindu State Agendas  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Kathmandu. Jay Nepal Party Chairman Dr. Dhawal Shamsher Rana has accused the Rastriya Prajatantra Party (RPP) of not being able to effectively advance the agenda of monarchy and Hindu state.

Addressing a press conference in Kathmandu on Thursday to provide information about the newly formed Jay Nepal Party, he accused the RPP of only collecting votes in the name of the king and Hindu religion.

He stated that after failing to achieve results from the RPP, they have embarked on a new political journey for the monarchy and Hindu state. He claimed that although the RPP collected public opinion in the name of the king for 37 years, they could not implement their core agendas when the public gave them an opportunity. He accused the party leadership of abandoning the agenda due to personal interests.

Chairman Rana stated that the bail of 97 percent of RPP candidates was forfeited in the past elections due to dissatisfaction with the RPP's activities. He claimed that the public's dissatisfaction with the RPP's activities was reflected in the elections, even though the public was not disillusioned with the agenda of monarchy and Hindu state.

He said, "The Rastriya Prajatantra Party collected votes in the name of the king for 37 years. Whenever the public put them in a position, they did not advance their agenda. They abandoned the agenda for the personal interests of the leaders."

Stating that this work could not be done by the RPP, he added, "In the past elections, the public forfeited the bail of 97 percent of RPP leaders. Now the agenda is ruined, it will be finished. The narrative that the public defeated the party that supported the king and Hindu state by 97 percent, that this agenda is finished, we have come out to rescue that agenda."

Clarifying that the Nepali people have not rejected the core ideology of the country, he said, "What we have understood is that the Nepali people have not rejected the Hindu kingdom or democracy with the king, but the votes did not come due to the activities of the Rastriya Prajatantra Party."

He stated that the Jay Nepal Party was established to save the agenda of monarchy and Hindu state from being considered finished, as a narrative began to form after the election results that the agenda of monarchy and Hindu state had ended. He claimed that the Nepali people have not rejected the concept of a Hindu kingdom or democracy with the king.
translated:
काठमांडू। जय नेपाल पार्टीक अध्यक्ष डा. धवल शमशेर राणा राष्ट्रिय प्रजातन्त्र पार्टी राजतन्त्र आ हिन्दू राज्यक एजेण्डा प्रभावी ढंगसँ आगू नहि बढ़ा सकबाक आरोप लगौलनि अछि ।

नवगठित जय नेपाल पार्टीक जानकारी देबाक लेल बृहस्पतिदिन काठमाण्डौमे पत्रकार सम्मेलन कए संबोधित करैत ओ रापापा पर मात्र राजा आ हिन्दू धर्मक नाम पर मत संकलन करबाक आरोप लगौलनि ।

हुनी कहलकै कि आरपीपी स॑ परिणाम नै मिलला के बाद राजतंत्र आरू हिन्दू राज्य लेली एगो नया राजनीतिक यात्रा प॑ निकली गेलऽ छै । हुनकऽ दावा छेलै कि भले ही आरपीपी ३७ साल तलक राजा के नाम प॑ जनमत जुटाबै छेलै, लेकिन जनता के मौका मिलला प॑ हुनी अपनऽ मूल एजेंडा क॑ लागू नै करी सकलै । ओ पार्टी नेतृत्व पर व्यक्तिगत स्वार्थ के कारण एजेंडा छोड़बाक आरोप लगौलनि।

अध्यक्ष राणा कहलनि जे, विगत चुनाव मे आरपीपी के गतिविधि सं असंतोष के कारण आरपीपी के 97 प्रतिशत उम्मीदवार के जमानत जब्त कएल गेल छल. हुनकऽ दावा छेलै कि राजतंत्र आरू हिन्दू राज्य केरऽ एजेंडा स॑ जनता के मोहभंग नै होय के बावजूद भी चुनाव म॑ जनता के असंतोष के झलक मिलै छै ।

ओ कहलनि जे, "राष्ट्रीय प्रजातंत्र पार्टी 37 साल तक राजा के नाम पर वोट जमा केलक। जखन कखनो जनता हुनका कोनो पद पर राखैत छल त ओ अपन एजेंडा के आगू नहि बढ़बैत छल। नेता के व्यक्तिगत हित के लेल एजेंडा के त्याग करैत छल।"

ई काम आरपीपी द्वारा नै करलऽ जाब॑ सकै छै, ई बात क॑ बतैतें हुअ॑ हुनी आरू कहलकै, "पिछला चुनाव म॑ जनता न॑ आरपीपी केरऽ ९७ प्रतिशत नेता के जमानत जब्त करी लेल॑ छेलै । अब॑ एजेंडा बर्बाद होय गेलऽ छै, ई समाप्त होय जैतै । ई कथ्य कि जनता न॑ राजा आरू हिन्दू राज्य केरऽ समर्थन करै वाला पार्टी क॑ ९७ प्रतिशत स॑ हरा देलकै, कि ई एजेंडा समाप्त होय गेलऽ छै, हम्मं॑ वू एजेंडा क॑ बचाबै लेली निकललऽ छियै ।"

देश के मूल विचारधारा के नेपाली जनता नकारल नै रहल स्पष्ट करैत ओ कहलनि जे, हम सब जे बुझलौं से ई जे नेपाली जनता राजा के संग हिन्दू राज्य या लोकतंत्र के अस्वीकार नै केलक अछि, मुदा राष्ट्रीय प्रजातंत्र पार्टी के गतिविधि के कारण वोट नै आयल।

ओ कहलनि जे, जय नेपाल पार्टीक स्थापना राजतंत्र आ हिन्दू राज्यक एजेंडा केँ समाप्त मानल जाय सँ बचाबय लेल कयल गेल छल, कारण चुनाव परिणामक बाद एकटा कथ्य बनय लागल जे राजतंत्र आ हिन्दू राज्यक एजेंडा समाप्त भ गेल अछि । ओ दावा केलनि जे नेपाली जनता राजाक संग हिन्दू राज्य वा लोकतंत्रक अवधारणा केँ खारिज नहि केलक अछि ।

title: Unrelated videos from Bangladesh are being shared as showing Hindus attacking Muslims in Nepal - FACTLY
description: Unrelated videos from Bangladesh are being shared as showing Hindus attacking Muslims in Nepal  FACTLY
publisher.title: FACTLY
full_article:
A A A

Communal violence broke out in Nepal’s Sunsari district on 27 July 2026 after clashes between Hindu and Muslim groups during separate religious events. The confrontation reportedly began over disputes involving loud music and the display of religious flags, escalating into stone-pelting, arson, and attacks on property. The unrest later spread to several areas of Madhesh Province, prompting authorities to impose curfews, deploy additional security personnel, and appeal for calm. Several people, including security personnel, were injured in the violence, while investigations were launched to identify those responsible (here, here, and here).

In this context, a couple of videos are being shared on social media with the claim that they show members of the Hindu community attacking members of the Muslim community in Nepal.

Claim: The video shows Hindus attacking members of the Muslim community in Nepal. Fact: None of the videos show Hindus attacking Muslims in Nepal. The first video is from Dhaka, Bangladesh, and shows supporters of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) allegedly attacking a Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami anti-extortion procession on 04 July 2026. The second video was also recorded in Comilla district, Bangladesh. While we could not independently verify the context of the second video, it is clear that it was not filmed in Nepal and is unrelated to the communal clashes there. Hence, the claim made in the post is Misleading.

Video 1

This video showing people attacking individuals with sticks on a road is being shared as proof of Hindus attacking members of the Muslim community in Nepal.

The archived post can be found here.

A reverse image search of key frames from the viral video led us to several social media posts (here, here, and here) published by Bangladeshi media outlets on 04 July 2026 featuring the same incident from different angles. According to these reports, the visuals show supporters of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) attacking a Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami anti-extortion procession in Gulistan, leaving at least 20 people injured.

We then conducted a Google search using relevant keywords and found several news reports (here, here, and here) about the incident. These reports stated that the clash took place in Gulistan, a commercial area in Dhaka, Bangladesh. The reports further noted that Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami blamed activists of the ruling Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) for the attack.

We also geolocated the video to the Jatrabari–Gulistan Flyover in Dhaka, Bangladesh. The blue flyover pillars, the building in the background, and other surrounding features match Google Maps Street View, confirming that the video was recorded in Bangladesh and is unrelated to the communal clashes in Nepal.

Video 2

This video, which shows a bearded man tied to a tree being assaulted by a group of youths, is being shared with the claim that it depicts the persecution of Muslims in Nepal.

The archived post can be found here.

Upon closely reviewing the viral video, we noticed the watermark @MD.SOIMUL. A search for this account led us to a longer version of the video, which was posted on 15 July 2026. Although the user did not provide any details about the incident, the account’s About section indicates that it is based in Bangladesh.

In the longer version of the video, we noticed the name “Dakshin Vinglabari Jame Masjid” (দক্ষিণ উইঙ্গালবাড়ি জামে মসজিদ) written on a mosque wall. We found that the mosque is located in Vinglabari village, Comilla district, Bangladesh. A comparison with Google Maps Street View showed that the surroundings match the viral video, confirming that it was recorded in Bangladesh.

To sum up, unrelated videos from Bangladesh are being shared as showing Hindus attacking Muslims in Nepal.

नेपाल के सुनसरी जिला में 27 जुलाई 2026 के अलग-अलग धार्मिक आयोजन के दौरान हिन्दू आ मुस्लिम समूह के बीच झड़प के बाद साम्प्रदायिक हिंसा भड़कल छल। खबर छै कि ई मुठभेड़ जोर-जोर स॑ संगीत आरू धार्मिक झंडा केरऽ प्रदर्शन स॑ जुड़लऽ विवाद के चलतें शुरू होलऽ छेलै, जेकरा स॑ बढ़ी क॑ पत्थरबाजी, आगजनी आरू संपत्ति प॑ हमला होय गेलै । बाद मे अशांति मधेश प्रांतक कतेको इलाका मे पसरल जाहि सँ अधिकारि लोकनि कर्फ्यू लगा देलनि, अतिरिक्त सुरक्षाकर्मी तैनात केलनि, आ शांतताक अपील केलनि। हिंसा म॑ सुरक्षाकर्मी सहित कई लोग घायल होय गेलै, जबकि जिम्मेदारऽ के पहचान करै लेली जांच शुरू करलऽ गेलै (एत॑, यहाँ, आरू यहाँ) ।

एहि क्रम मे एक दू टा वीडियो सोशल मीडिया पर शेयर कएल जा रहल अछि जाहि मे नेपाल मे हिन्दू समुदायक सदस्य मुस्लिम समुदायक सदस्य पर हमला करैत देखाओल गेल अछि ।

दावा : वीडियो मे नेपाल मे मुस्लिम समुदाय के सदस्य पर हिन्दू हमला करैत देखा रहल अछि। तथ्य : कोनो वीडियो मे नेपाल मे हिन्दू मुसलमान पर हमला करैत नहि देखाओल गेल अछि । पहिलऽ वीडियो बांग्लादेश केरऽ ढाका केरऽ छै, जेकरा म॑ बांग्लादेश राष्ट्रवादी पार्टी (बीएनपी) केरऽ समर्थक न॑ कथित तौर प॑ ०४ जुलाई २०२६ क॑ बंगलादेश जमात-ए-इस्लामी रंगदारी विरोधी जुलूस प॑ हमला करी रहलऽ छै ।दूसरऽ वीडियो बांग्लादेश केरऽ कोमिला जिला म॑ भी रिकॉर्ड करलऽ गेलऽ छेलै । जखन कि हम सब स्वतंत्र रूप स दोसर वीडियो क संदर्भ क सत्यापन नहि क सकलहुं, मुदा इ साफ अछि जे एकर फिल्मांकन नेपाल मे नहि भेल छल आ ओतय के सांप्रदायिक झड़प स असंबंधित अछि। एहि लेल पोस्ट मे जे दावा कएल गेल अछि ओ भ्रामक अछि।

वीडियो 1

सड़क पर व्यक्ति पर लाठी स हमला करय वाला ई वीडियो नेपाल मे मुस्लिम समुदाय के सदस्य पर हिन्दू के हमला के प्रमाण के रूप मे शेयर कएल जा रहल अछि.

संग्रहीत पोस्ट एतय भेटत।

वायरल वीडियो स॑ प्रमुख फ्रेमऽ के रिवर्स इमेज सर्च स॑ हमरा सब क॑ ०४ जुलाई २०२६ क॑ बांग्लादेशी मीडिया द्वारा प्रकाशित कईएक सोशल मीडिया पोस्ट (एत॑, यहाँ, आरू यहाँ) मिललै जेकरा म॑ एक ही घटना क॑ अलग-अलग कोण स॑ पेश करलऽ गेलऽ छेलै । ई खबरऽ के अनुसार विजुअलऽ म॑ बंगलादेश राष्ट्रवादी पार्टी (बीएनपी) के समर्थकऽ न॑ गुलिस्तान म॑ बांग्लादेश जमात-ए-इस्लामी रंगदारी विरोधी जुलूस प॑ हमला करतें हुअ॑ कम स॑ कम २० लोग घायल होय गेलऽ छै ।

एकर बाद हम सब प्रासंगिक कीवर्ड क उपयोग कए गूगल सर्च केलहुं आ एहि घटना क बारे मे कईटा न्यूज रिपोर्ट (एतय, एतय, आ एतय) भेटल। ई खबरऽ म॑ कहलऽ गेलऽ छै कि ई झड़प बांग्लादेश केरऽ ढाका केरऽ एगो व्यावसायिक क्षेत्र गुलिस्तान म॑ भेलऽ छै । रिपोर्ट मँ आगू कहलौ गेलौ छै कि बांग्लादेश जमात-ए-इस्लामी नँ ई हमला लेली सत्तारूढ़ बांग्लादेश राष्ट्रवादी पार्टी (बीएनपी) केरौ कार्यकर्ता सिनी क जिम्मेदार ठहरौलकै ।

हम वीडियो के बांग्लादेश के ढाका में जतराबारी–गुलिस्तान फ्लाईओवर तक जियोलोकेशन सेहो केलहुं। नील रंग के फ्लाईओवर के खंभा, पृष्ठभूमि में भवन, आरू आसपास के अन्य विशेषता गूगल मैप्स स्ट्रीट व्यू स॑ मेल खाबै छै, जेकरा स॑ ई बात के पुष्टि होय छै कि ई वीडियो बांग्लादेश म॑ रिकॉर्ड करलऽ गेलऽ छै आरू नेपाल म॑ घटित सांप्रदायिक झड़प स॑ एकरऽ संबंध नै छै ।

वीडियो 2

गाछ मे बान्हल दाढ़ी वाला आदमी के युवक के समूह द्वारा मारपीट करय के ई वीडियो शेयर कएल जा रहल अछि जे एहि मे नेपाल मे मुसलमान के उत्पीड़न के चित्रण अछि.

संग्रहीत पोस्ट एतय भेटत।

वायरल वीडियो के बारीकी स समीक्षा केला पर हमरा सब के वॉटरमार्क @MD.SOIMUL देखल गेल। ई खाता खोजला पर हमरा सब क॑ ई वीडियो केरऽ एगो लम्बा संस्करण मिललै, जे १५ जुलाई २०२६ क॑ पोस्ट करलऽ गेलऽ छेलै ।हालांकि उपयोगकर्ता न॑ ई घटना के बारे म॑ कोय विवरण नै देलकै, लेकिन खाता केरऽ About सेक्शन स॑ पता चलै छै कि ई बांग्लादेश म॑ स्थित छै ।

वीडियो के नम्हर संस्करण में हमरा सब के एकटा मस्जिद के देवाल पर लिखल “दक्षिण विंगलाबारी जामे मस्जिद” (দক্ষিনা মঙ্গলবাড়ি জামেসজিদ) नाम पर नजरि पड़ल। हमरा सब के पता चलल जे ई मस्जिद बांग्लादेश के कोमिला जिला के विंगलाबारी गाम में अछि | गूगल मैप्स स्ट्रीट व्यू के साथ तुलना करला पर पता चललै कि आसपास के माहौल वायरल वीडियो स॑ मेल खाबै छै, जेकरा स॑ ई बात के पुष्टि होय छै कि ई वीडियो बांग्लादेश म॑ रिकॉर्ड करलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

संक्षेप मे कहल जाय त बांग्लादेश सं असंबंधित वीडियो शेयर कएल जा रहल अछि जेना नेपाल मे हिन्दू मुसलमान पर हमला करैत देखा रहल अछि.
